title: NVBC (No Villager Breeding Cooldown)
description: This plugin removes the cooldown of villager breeding, allowing you to breed the same villagers immediately after.
body:
NVBC (No Villager Breeding Cooldown) is a utility plugin that removes the villager breeding cooldown.


Commands:

Check if the plugin is enabled or not
```
/nvbc status
```
Toggle the plugin's functionality 
```
/nvbc toggle
```
Reload the plugin's configuration
```
/nvbc reload
```


Permission:

```
nvbc.admin
```
(Or OP)
